userParameters.name: table_h
userParameters.comment: Overall table height, floor to top surface

userParameters.name: splay
userParameters.comment: Leg splay/rake angle from vertical, per axis

userParameters.name: tongue_ov
userParameters.comment: Panel tongue protrusion into the frame groove

userParameters.name: tf_cham_d
userParameters.comment: Top-frame edge profile depth (inward from outer face)

userParameters.name: tf_cham_h
userParameters.comment: Top-frame edge profile height (up from bottom face)

userParameters.name: tf_tn_d
userParameters.comment: 格角榫 tenon depth into the stile (template tenon_depth 1.5/3.5 of width)

userParameters.name: tf_tn_st
userParameters.comment: 格角榫 tenon shoulder at the INNER edge (template tenon_shoulder_top 1.2/3.5)

userParameters.name: tf_tn_sb
userParameters.comment: 格角榫 tenon shoulder at the OUTER edge (template tenon_shoulder_bot 0.6/3.5)

userParameters.name: leg_setback_x
userParameters.comment: Distance each leg is set in from the table END (X)

userParameters.name: leg_setback_y
userParameters.comment: Distance each leg is set in from the table SIDE (Y)

userParameters.name: ltx
userParameters.comment: Leg half-spread in X = legs at +/-ltx (derived)

userParameters.name: lty
userParameters.comment: Leg half-spread in Y = legs at +/-lty (derived)

userParameters.name: leg_embed
userParameters.comment: How far the leg top embeds up into the frame

userParameters.name: fbd_tail_w
userParameters.comment: Dovetail tail width at wide face

userParameters.name: spandrel_depth
userParameters.comment: Spandrel vertical extent below the apron

userParameters.name: shelf_z
userParameters.comment: Shelf top height above the floor

userParameters.name: bt_dt_d
userParameters.comment: Batten dovetail depth into the panel

userParameters.name: foot_off
userParameters.comment: Leg foot splay offset per axis (derived)

userParameters.name: slot_w
userParameters.comment: Leg slot width (spans the leg in X)

userParameters.name: slot_gap
userParameters.comment: Leg slot gap in Y (< spandrel thickness)

userParameters.name: ap_end_inset
userParameters.comment: Apron end inset from each frame end

userParameters.name: sa_w
userParameters.comment: Short-apron height: apron_w narrowed for the long apron's lean so bottom edges meet level (derived)

userParameters.name: sf_tn_h
userParameters.comment: Shelf-rail tenon height = FULL thickness (reaches top + bottom, no shoulder)

userParameters.name: sf_tn_z
userParameters.comment: Shelf-rail tenon bottom Z = rail bottom (derived)
